headline: Approved a $34,000 donation for the BCHS Press Box project and several policy and bylaw revisions.
summary: Members approved three curriculum revisions, including Latin Historical Prose and Algebra 2. Several policies were revised, including those on cyberbullying and suspension and expulsion. Staff reported a 20.3% chronic absenteeism rate for 2025–2026, about 2% higher than the prior year.
decisions: Approved the September 9, 2026 Regular Meeting Minutes as written, unanimously.
Approved the September 9, 2026 Special Meeting Minutes, unanimously.
Approved the September 23, 2026 Special Meeting Minutes, 7-0-2, with two abstentions.
Approved the consent agenda, including personnel items and nine grants, unanimously.
Approved the Latin Historical Prose curriculum, unanimously.
Approved revisions to the Middle School (Grades 6–8) Science curriculum, unanimously.
Approved revisions to the Algebra 2 curriculum, unanimously.
Approved revisions to Policy 3231, Medical Reimbursement for Special Education Students.
Approved revisions to Policy 5114, Suspension and Expulsion/Due Process.
Approved revisions to Policy 4111/4211, Recruitment and Selection.
Approved revisions to Policy 5131.8, Out of School Misconduct, 7-0-2, with two abstentions.
Approved revised Policy 1120, Public Participation at Board of Education Meetings, with corrected language in item #8, 7-0-2, with two abstentions.
Approved revisions to Bylaw 9325, Meeting Conduct, 7-0-2, with two abstentions.
Approved revisions to Bylaw 9322, Public and Executive Sessions, unanimously.
Approved a $34,000 donation from the BCHS Athletics Activities account to the BCHS Press Box project.
Approved June 11, 2027 as the graduation date for the Class of 2027.
Took no action on the first review of draft school calendars for 2027/2028 and 2028/2029; a second review is planned for the next meeting.
Took no action on the first review of proposed 2027 meeting dates.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board of Education voted to approve the September 9, 2026 Regular Meeting Minutes as written. Motion made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Kara Ledger. Motion passed unanimously.
The Board of Education voted to approve the September 9, 2026 Special Meeting Minutes.. Motion made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Kara Ledger. Motion passed unanimously.

The Board of Education voted to approve the September 23, 2026 Special Meeting Minutes as written. Motion made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. The motion carried 7-0-2 with (2) abstention from Commissioners Jennifer Van Gorder & Kristen Giantonio.
Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the consent agenda, which included items from 8.1.a to 7.2.h. Motion made by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula and seconded by Kara Ledger. Motion passed unanimously.
Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the Latin Historical Prose curriculum as presented. Motion made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Kara Ledger. The motion passed unanimously.

Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to approve the revisions to the Middle School (Grades 6–8) Science curriculum as presented. Motion made by Kara Ledger and seconded by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. The motion passed unanimously.
Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to approve the Algebra 2 curriculum revisions as presented. Motion made by Kara Ledger and seconded by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. The motion passed unanimously.

Vice Chair Tagariello called for a motion to approve the revisions to Policy 3231 – Medical Reimbursement for Special Education Students as presented. Motion made by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula and seconded by Kara Ledger. The motion passed.

Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the revisions to Policy 5114 – Suspension and Expulsion/Due Process as presented. Motion made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Barbara Tedesco. The motion passed.
Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the revisions to Policy 5131.913 – Cyberbullying as presented. Motion made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Barbara Tedesco. The motion passed.

Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the revisions to Policy 4111/4211 – Recruitment and Selection as presented. Motion made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Kara Ledger. The motion passed.

Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the revisions to Policy 5131.8 Out of School Misconduct as presented. A motion was made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. The motion carried 7-0-2 with (2) abstention from Commissioners Jennifer Van Gorder & Kristen Giantonio.

Following discussion, Chair Pons called for a revised motion with the corrected language of #8 to Policy 1120 Public Participation at Board of Education Meetings. A motion was made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. The motion carried 7-0-2 with (2) abstention from Commissioners Jennifer Van Gorder & Kristen Giantonio.

Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the revisions to Bylaw 9325 Meeting Conduct as presented. A motion was made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. The motion carried 7-0-2 with (2) abstention from Commissioners Jennifer Van Gorder & Kristen Giantonio.

Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the revisions to Bylaw 9322 Public and Executive Sessions as presented. A motion was made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Jill Fitzsimons-Bula. The motion was carried unanimously.

Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the Donation of $34,000 from the BCHS Athletics Activities account to the BCHS Press Box project. Motion made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Kara Ledger. The motion passed.
Chair Pons called for a motion to approve June 11, 2027 as the graduation date for the Class of 2027. Motion made by Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Kara Ledger. The motion passed.
No action was taken, draft calendars will be presented for a second review at the next Board of Education meeting.

The Board conducted a first review of proposed 2027 Board of Education meeting dates. Two scheduling options were presented, one beginning meetings at 6:30 p.m. and another at 7:00 p.m. Commissioners will provide their preferences for further consideration. No action was taken.
